QUOTE: "1. Split the entry at the first `:`. 2. The left side is an `fnmatch` glob matched against the fully-qualified tool name. With no `:`, the tool-name match is enough. 3. The right side is an `fnmatch` glob matched against `tool_name:<value>`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
